SELECT id, user_id, user_name, avatar_name, avatar_path, password, pwd_reset_time, is_admin, enable_flag, delete_flag, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, renter_id FROM freedom_user_t WHERE user_id = #{param.userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE freedom_user_t SET user_id = #{userId}, user_name = #{userName}, avatar_name = #{avatarName}, avatar_path = #{avatarPath}, password = #{password}, pwd_reset_time = #{pwdResetTime}, is_admin = #{isAdmin}, enable_flag = #{enableFlag}, delete_flag = #{deleteFlag}, create_by = #{createBy}, update_by = #{updateBy}, create_time = #{createTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, renter_id = #{renterId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT fut.id, fut.user_id, fut.user_name, fut.avatar_name, fut.avatar_path, fut.password, fut.pwd_reset_time, fut.is_admin, fut.create_time, fut.update_time, frt.role_name FROM freedom_user_t fut join freedom_user_role_t furt on fut.id = furt.user_id join freedom_role_t frt on furt.role_id = frt.id WHERE fut.enable_flag = 'Y' AND fut.delete_flag = 'N' ORDER BY fut.create_time DESC
